fact: Regulation 17A of the PPCA amended regulations (February 2026) requires procurement to be conducted through the e-procurement system and requires it to support the full procurement cycle, from notices and e-submission of bids to evaluation, award notices and contract publication.
title: Public Procurement and Concessions Act 2005 as amended and restated in 2010 & 2026: Amended Regulations - 2026.01
